item_name: Rothco Web Belts With Flip Buckle - Black
item_short_desc: Rothco's Web Belt with Flip Buckle combines durability and versatility in a classic design suitable for any outfit. Crafted from 100% cotton, this duty belt is built for strength and comfort, ideal for both work and casual wear. Measuring 1.25 inch wide and 54 inch long, it provides a comfortable fit and is easy to adjust by cutting the webbing to your desired length, making it perfect for BDU pants, jeans, cargo shorts, and more. The sturdy flip-top buckle securely holds the belt in place while adding a timeless, polished look.
